extracted.name: Super Easy Slow Cooker Chicken Enchilada Meat
extracted.description: This easy slow cooker recipe delivers tender chicken in an enchilada sauce perfect for your favorite Mexican dishes.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch cayenne pepper, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Place chicken broth, tomatoes, flour, chili powder, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, and cayenne into a blender; blend until smooth.
Place chicken breasts in a slow cooker; pour blended sauce over chicken.
Cover slow cooker. Cook on Low 8 to 9 hours (or on High 4 to 6 hours).
Shred chicken with 2 forks; stir into sauce.
